module_signals.finding: Q3'26 report and 2026 interim report read directly from HKEX; share count from the monthly return. Consensus (LSEG via Reuters), policy terms (MOF No.20 via search), sell-side actions and share data are secondary. Export-rebate terms unverified.

Global EV-battery share 39.4% (8M 2026, +1.7pp); overseas revenue +42% to 31.5% of H1; ESS +88% in H1 and #1 globally. Against: China passenger retail -28% YoY in Sept; China installation share 40.9% (Sept) from 49.8% (Jan) as BYD rose to 21.1%; Q4 top-5 production pipeline +1% m/m vs +7% expected.

Gross margin 20.7% in Q3 from 23.93% in H1 (mix to ESS, competition, 2% consumption tax from 2026-09-01). Scale, net cash and overseas plants protect the pool; tax steps to 4% on 2027-09-01 and an export-rebate cut (terms unverified) are a 2027 headwind JPM sizes at >CNY 100B for the industry.

Net cash ~CNY 260B. But 9M OCF 61.6B (-24% YoY) vs NI +32%: inventories +53% to 144.8B, receivables +48% to 112.9B, short-term borrowings x3 to 39.9B, bonds payable 3.4B -> 52.7B, construction in progress +45%.

Policy (consumption tax 2%->4%, export rebate), demand (12-month China auto downturn), structure (BYD vertical integration, OEM dual-sourcing), market (H short ratio ~18%, JPM/Citi/GS cuts), geopolitics (US FEOC, EU tariffs).

At H 411.80 (CNY 350.3): base 5y IRR +1.5%, bear -16.5%, bull +13.7%, tax-stress -2.3%; 8%-neutral entry HKD 302 (base) / 249 (stress). At A 259.08: base +7.8%, at the band top. The 35% H premium is the whole difference. P/E ~14x (A) / ~19x (H) on 2026E CNY 18.4/share.

binding_constraint: PRICE on the H line (H/A premium 35%); EVIDENCE on the A line (Q4 gross margin, 2027 tax pass-through, export-rebate text)

runner_dissent: The bull case writes itself: the world's #1 battery maker, revenue +56%, net cash CNY 260B, ~14x this year's earnings on the A line after a 45% drawdown, with overseas and ESS growing faster than the group; the Q3 'miss' was against a consensus that assumed margins would hold, and profit still grew 14.5%. The counter: this card is for a holder who can only buy H, and H costs 35% more per unit of earnings than A for reasons (flows, a 218M-share float) unrelated to the business. At ~19x on a year whose Q4 carries a new tax and a demand air-pocket, with a 4% tax step and an unverified rebate cut in 2027, the hurdle is not met on H. On A it is roughly met today; that line deserves the full underwriting (operator, value chain, moat) this folder does not yet have.
